Well, happy new year for anyone in near, and hope you will have a great 2026 onward. There might be unexpected turns and so on, but unless we quit on life, life will not quit on us. So that is a thing to bare upon, and should to be taken seriously of. That said, today's inquiry note is not simply about *anything of congratulation*, but more on the side of the very title topic - the *misrepresentation* or *trust issue* on overclaims of physical theory. More so apparent, from the two simple construct - *metric tensor* and *Gibbs theory*. Granted, however, it all is because of a subtle debate, more so heated, on wine of the end of the year. That said, we have something to talk about this topic in specificity of general. The same contents here will be included, or rather expanded in a later paper of the title on *metric space and Gibbs physical theory - system and overclaims*, or sort of which. 

So, what gives? To consider it bluntly, take forth on the theory of *model*, or rather, the concept of which model constitutes. A model $M$ is meant to be the replica on $\mathcal{O}$ of the oracle, i.e. the *physical world* realizable in physics sense, of particular interest, and such. Within it, comes the world of which one claims as the *universal model*, i.e. the theory of unity between all. Such is often said to be able to realize from the world itself, to a degree of notice. Hence, comes the toolset and the frame of understanding we have. For example, to not as familiar as we often heard of metric tensor in general relativity, the Gibbs measure, Gibbs free energy, paradoxes, and so on, arise into a form of which can be called the **family of Gibbs-style statistical physics**. Such is inherent of such, as those analyses themselves depends on certain amount of *constraints*, assumptions of which are often *hidden in plain sight*, conjectures holding in certain specified regions, heuristics of structural interpretations, and effective information of the model system of interest itself. All of which, disqualify it to be a unified theory from the onset. Such can be extended for even the standard model, and so on, in a glimpse of though. Metric tensor, i.e. $g_{\mu \nu}$ on specified manifold, is the *effective framework* to encode angles, distances, and such, is also a case in which it is not simply 'natural', or rather 'intrinsic of the universe' as typical physicists thought. There is no guarantee it is the physical reality other than acute coordinate-like system, even though it of itself is often understood to be *coordinate agnostic*, thus all for a roundabout. That said, such sentiment of the theory of everything, of the modelling choice (for example, is the *frame problem* reformed on physics to say that no theory can get all information, or encode everything of all cases, under all circumstances, of all realizable systems and of all observables as they are a specific encoding chosen for the world), the question about the pathway between oracle $\mathcal{O}$ and $M$, to which degree one obtain the relative *general theory* typically seen constructed in physics, and so on, while disregarding such discrepancy. We often forget that we are studying the world from the lens of our own language, of such virtue thrown out because of the belief to capture the universe in our hand, while beautiful is intellectually shallow thus useless. The mainstay of this article, is to lay out such problem, and to reframe for those who try to justify otherwise. Ignorant is a bliss. Thematic is a killing. 

## Foremost analysis

So, first, what are those concepts that we have mentioned, metric tensor and Gibbs physics. So, let's get into the first topic, not in order, the *Gibbs* formulation of statistical physics.
